newsitem.title: USA: US equity funds up 3.71 pct in Q4 thru Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: US equity funds up 3.71 pct in Q4 thru Dec 12.

text.p: The average U.S. equity fund has risen 3.71 percent for the fourth quarter through December 12, according to Lipper Analytical Services, but the sector has lost about 1.49 percent over the last two weeks.
S&P 500 index funds led all broad sectors, gaining 6.50 percent for the quarter through December 12, followed by growth and income funds, up 5.76 percent, and equity income funds, up 5.64 percent.
Among more narrow sectors, real estate funds rose 9.29 percent for the period, financial services added 8.55 percent, and science and technology funds were up 8.10 percent.
Japanese funds shed seven percent for the period, while gold oriented funds were the big losers at 4.49 percent.
Lipper will release final full-quarter results for equity funds on January 3.
